faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Project Technical Support-I post at AIIMS Nagpur is 27 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Support-I at AIIMS Nagpur?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Project Technical Support-I post in the AIIMS Nagpur recruitment drive. This offers a specific opportunity for eligible candidates in the relevant fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support-I position?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Project Technical Support-I post should not exceed 28 years of age. This maximum age limit is a key eligibility criterion for applicants.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for Project Technical Support-I?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Bachelor's Degree in public health, social sciences, life sciences, healthcare management, or a related field from a recognized institution or university to be eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Technical Support-I at AIIMS Nagpur?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Technical Support-I position will receive a salary of Rs. 18000 per month, along with HRA as admissible. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates, for the AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support-I recruitment. This makes the application process accessible to all.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Project Technical Support-I?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Technical Support-I post includes an Interview and a Written Exam. Candidates will be evaluated based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support-I post?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of AIIMS Nagpur. The application link will be available in the Important Links section of the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, a walk-in interview is scheduled for 29 September 2026. Candidates who apply online might also need to attend this interview as part of the selection process.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for the Project Technical Support-I post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Technical Support-I position will be in Nagpur, Maharashtra. This is an excellent opportunity for candidates seeking government jobs in the region.
